description: Free preview: decompose a claim into sub-claims, fetch the sources live (or search for them), classify each source and group sources into independent families, and show exactly what a paid fact_check_claim would check. No verdict, no jury calls, no payment.

claim.description: The claim to fact-check, as a single statement or a short paragraph.

sources.description: Optional public HTTPS source URLs to check against (max 8). When omitted or fewer than 2 are usable, ClaimGate searches the live web.

name: fact_check_preview
title: Fact Check Preview
